title: No Game No Life: Disboard
alt: A wide bright land seen from a high cliff, under a blue sky that is pale rose low down. At the edge of the world stand chess pieces as high as the sky, pale violet in the far air: a rook, a knight, a bishop, a king, a queen, a pawn and a second rook. Islands of rock float in the air in front of them, with grass on top and water falling from them, and a great pale moon stands at the right. Below lie green fields, woods, a winding river and a small walled city with red roofs. On the cliff, in long grass with flowers, a boy in a yellow shirt and a small girl with very long white hair stand hand in hand with their backs to us. The boy holds a hand over his eyes.
summary: A painting of Sora and Shiro looking out over Disboard from No Game No Life in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Disboard, from No Game No Life, the novels by Yuu Kamiya. Sora and Shiro are a brother and a sister who have never lost a game. A god calls them to his world, where every quarrel is settled by a game.

The pieces at the edge of the world are his. The city below is Elkia, the last city of the people who have no magic. We see the two from behind, hand in hand. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
